indexLead: We compare brands by the specs of their models from the last 4 years in our catalogue — typical values and the best models, not marketing.
vsLead: {a} and {b} compared on {m} specs, using {na} and {nb} models from the last 4 years. Typical value = median; best = top 10% of the brand's models.
method: How we compare: only manufacturer specifications from our catalogue, no paid placements. A brand's typical value shows what you usually get; the best value shows its top models. Check the exact model before you buy.
